title: Reggae One
description: Fontworks が Google Fonts に開放した極太のディスプレイ書体。筆の勢いを残したエッジで、叫び・強ツッコミの演出に向く。OFL-1.1 のため実体同梱への昇格も可能（現状は索引のみ）。
when_to_use: 強めのツッコミ・叫びテロップ、バラエティの決め文字に

en.title: Reggae One
en.description: An ultra-bold display typeface released by Fontworks on Google Fonts. Its brushlike edges suit shouted lines and strong retorts. OFL-1.1 permits bundling the font later; currently this is a reference-only listing.
en.when_to_use: For forceful retorts, shouted captions, and standout variety-show text.
